summary: Iteration 14 targeted testing: vendor sidebar consolidation (4 links), /vendor/more page, Catalogue route regression, and distance-based delivery fee end-to-end. Found and fixed a CRITICAL blocker: OrderIn Pydantic model was missing the distance_km field, so EVERY POST /api/orders returned 500 (AttributeError). After adding the field, 13/13 backend tests pass and both distance tiers verified end-to-end in the UI (near => delivery ₹13, far => ₹20, subtotal >= ₹499 => free). Remaining HIGH issue: the checkout Order-summary/UPI QR always shows ₹20 delivery (client constant) even when 'Within 1.5 km (₹13)' is selected, so displayed total (₹45) differs from actual charged total (₹38).

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: create_order read payload.distance_km but OrderIn had no distance_km field -> AttributeError -> HTTP 500 on every order placement (complete checkout outage). Added `distance_km: Optional[float] = None` to OrderIn in /app/backend/server.py. Main agent should keep this and add a model-level test.

minor.issue: distance_km is used to compute the fee but is not persisted on the order document, so vendor/delivery panels and admin cannot see the delivery distance/tier for an order.
allow_credentials=True combined with default allow_origins='*' is an invalid/insecure combination; browsers reject credentialed wildcard origins. Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS.

ui_bugs.issue: Delivery is rendered from CartContext's hardcoded DELIVERY_FEE=20, so selecting 'Within 1.5 km (₹13)' still shows Delivery ₹20, Total ₹45 and 'Scan & pay ₹45', while the server charges ₹13 (order total ₹38). Customer is shown/asked to pay the wrong amount. Derive the displayed fee from the selected distance_km (13 if <=1.5km) or fetch a server quote.

issues: Sidebar label renamed to 'Catalogue' but the page heading still reads 'Products (4)' — inconsistent naming
'Business Details' tile links to the same /vendor/settings page and 'Commission & Earnings' links to the same /vendor/analytics page as two other tiles (duplicate destinations, no deep-link/anchor)
'Bank Details' and 'Support' tiles reuse the generic Store icon
No 404/catch-all route at app level — unknown top-level paths render a completely blank page with only the header

action_items: Keep/verify the OrderIn.distance_km field added by the tester (was the cause of 500 on all order placements) — add a regression test so the model and handler stay in sync.
Fix checkout delivery-fee display to reflect the selected distance option (₹13 vs ₹20) including the UPI 'Scan & pay' amount.
Persist distance_km (and the resolved delivery tier) on the order document for vendor/delivery visibility.
Rename the Catalogue page heading from 'Products' to 'Catalogue' for consistency.
Add an app-level 404/catch-all route so unknown paths do not render a blank page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: handler referenced a Pydantic attribute that was never declared — this class of bug is invisible until runtime; keep the model and handler edits together.

CartContext.jsx duplicates the delivery-fee business rule client-side (DELIVERY_FEE=20 / FREE_THRESHOLD=499); with distance tiers this is now guaranteed to drift from the server. Prefer a single server-side quote endpoint.
VendorDashboard.jsx is 859 lines and hosts Dashboard/Orders/Analytics/Settings/More components in one file — split into /pages/vendor/*.jsx.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the 500 on POST /api/orders: create_order (server.py:603) accessed payload.distance_km, but the OrderIn Pydantic model never declared distance_km, so extra JSON keys were dropped and attribute access raised AttributeError ('OrderIn' object has no attribute 'distance_km'), surfacing as 500 for every order — including requests that omitted distance_km. Reproduction: POST /api/orders with any valid payload -> 500; backend.err.log shows the AttributeError traceback. Mitigation applied: declared distance_km: Optional[float] = None on OrderIn.
